file.notApplied: The file on disk is not applied; its last good version is in use

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One profile per person, from every linked product. People are matched only by email, phone or your user id.
overview.knownRest: the rest by phone or user id
overview.mergedDetail: same email, phone or user id from two sources
overview.noEvents: Events from Analytics, Forms, CRM, Messages, imports and the API show here.
overview.segmentSizesDetail: Size now and the change over 30 days

people.title: People
people.description: Every profile with its traits and latest activity. Two records are one person only when they share an email, a phone number or your user id.
people.searchPlaceholder: Name, email, phone or user id
people.noneDetail: People come from Analytics, Forms, CRM, Messages, a CSV import or the API.
people.pick: Choose a person to see their profile.

person.gone: This person is not here any more.
person.name: Name
person.merged: Joined from {{count}} earlier profiles that shared an email, phone or user id.

add.title: Add a person
add.description: By email, phone or user id. Someone already here with one of them is updated, not added twice.
add.matched: Phone numbers without a country code take the one in the file.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The profile and its events are deleted here and in every linked product. The request is logged without the person's data.

in.analytics: Analytics: the visits of this person

delete.done: {{name}} is deleted here, and {{products}} are asked to delete them too. The request is logged.
delete.doneHere: {{name}} is deleted. The request is logged.

segments.title: Segments
segments.description: Rules on traits and on events in a period. A person is in a segment while its rules hold, and leaves it as soon as they do not.
segments.noneDetail: A segment is a rule, such as plan is Free and viewed /pricing in the last 30 days. Messages and Campaigns send to it.
segments.gone: This segment is not here any more.
segments.notUsed: not read by another product yet
segments.useNotice: Messages reads {{name}} at {{path}} with its own token. Each person's consent is checked when it sends.
segments.deleteDetail: The segment and its history are deleted; the people stay.
segments.deleteUsed: {{by}} read it in the last 30 days and will not find it any more. The people stay.
segments.historyDetail: People join and leave as they act.
segments.historyPeriod: People join and leave as they act; rules with a period are counted again every {{minutes}} minutes.

editor.description: Rules on traits, on events in a period, and on how people are known. The count below follows as you change them.
editor.name: Name
editor.nested: These rules have groups in groups; change them through the API. The name and description can be changed here.

imports.title: Imports
imports.description: People from a CSV: each column goes to an email, phone, user id or a trait. Rows are matched to existing profiles, never guessed.
imports.uploadDetail: A header line, then one person per row. Commas, semicolons and tabs are all read.
imports.consentNote: Consent is not assumed for imported people; Consent records only what people agreed to.
imports.noKey: Choose at least one column to match by
imports.noKeyDetail: Without an email, phone or user id a row cannot be matched to a person, so nothing would be imported.
imports.expected: Expected: {{created}} new profiles, {{matched}} matched to people already here, {{skipped}} rows skipped.
imports.phoneCountry: Phone numbers without a country code are taken to be in {{country}}.
imports.problems: Rows with a value that could not be read
imports.done: Imported: {{created}} new, {{matched}} matched, {{skipped}} skipped. Their consent is not assumed; Consent records only what people agreed to.

requests.title: Deletion requests
requests.description: A person deleted on request is deleted in every linked product too. The log keeps the reference and the time, never the person's data.
requests.recordDetail: By email, phone or user id, also for someone without a profile here: every linked product is asked to delete them.
requests.recorded: {{reference}} is recorded: {{profiles}} profiles deleted here, the linked products follow.
requests.retried: {{reference}}: the linked products were asked again.
requests.noneDetail: Delete a person on request from their profile, or record a request here.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: The products Audience is linked to, as audience.yaml sets them, and the APIs the others use.
integrations.noAddress: none: set url in the file, or the product in OPENASY_PRODUCTS

how.analytics: Visitors identified on the site become profiles, with their visits.
how.consent: Each profile shows what the person agreed to.
how.forms: Each form sent is an event on the person's timeline.
how.crm: Contacts and deals become profiles and events.
how.messages: Sends, opens and clicks are events; it sends to segments.

integrations.eventsApiDetail: Forms, CRM, Messages and your applications send events here with an Audience token of the editor role.
integrations.segmentsApiDetail: Messages and Campaigns read a segment's members, and who joined and left, with a viewer token.
integrations.reference: Every route, with its request and answer:

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Set in {{file}} with the rest of the install. Shown here as applied; changed in the file, not here.
settings.readOnlyDetail: Edit the file and commit it. Audience reads it again within a minute, and a file with a mistake keeps the last good one in place. Members, sign-in and API tokens have their own pages.
settings.matchingDetail: How two records become one person.
settings.phonesValue: Without a country code, taken to be in {{country}}
settings.empty: The file is empty: the defaults apply.
settings.askAnAdmin: Ask an admin of this Audience.
settings.accountDetail: Your name, password, passkeys and second factor.
settings.membersDetail: Who may sign in to Audience, and with which role.
settings.signinDetail: Identity providers people sign in with.
settings.tokensDetail: For the products and scripts that send events or read segments. One role each, always an expiry.

setup.title: Set up Audience
setup.description: Three steps: the file, the first events, the first segment.
setup.step1Detail: In {{path}}: how people are matched, the traits you keep, and the linked products with the variables that hold their tokens.
setup.step2Detail: With an API token of the editor role, made under Settings, API tokens. Linked Analytics is read on its own.
setup.step3Detail: Here under Segments, or with the API. Messages reads its members with a viewer token.
